claim: qwen35_cuda_forward_single_matches_cpu_logits_end_to_end reads pos0 rel L-inf 7.105e-2 on gx10 (GB10 sm_121, aarch64) vs 6.721e-2 on lambda (RTX 4090 sm_89, x86_64); same GGUF sha256 bd258782e35f7f45 both hosts

hypotheses.H1: the delta is on the CPU REFERENCE side (aarch64 NEON Q8_K activation-quant path vs x86 AVX2), not the GPU
hypotheses.H2: the delta is on the GPU side (sm_121 kernel numerics differ from sm_89)

method: env-gated dump of gpu+cpu logits per position on both hosts; cross-diff gpu_gx10 vs gpu_lambda and cpu_gx10 vs cpu_lambda (rel L-inf), and each GPU vs each CPU

falsifiers.H1: H1 FALSE if rel_linf(cpu_gx10,cpu_lambda) < 1e-3 at pos0 (CPU references agree)
falsifiers.H2: H2 FALSE if rel_linf(gpu_gx10,gpu_lambda) < 1e-3 at pos0 (GPUs agree)

decision_rule: If H2 is false and H1 holds: not an sm_121 defect; the budget is a property of the (host CPU ISA) reference, derive per-reference budget from the cross-host measurement. If H2 holds: localize per stage before any budget change.

decision: not an sm_121 defect; LOGITS_BUDGET keyed on host CPU arch: x86_64 7e-2 (worst 6.721e-2), aarch64 8e-2 (worst 7.105e-2 rounded up to 1 sig fig, the file's existing rule)
